title: WebSearchRequestV1
description: Model-facing query intent only. Trusted code derives route, provider, credential, auth/cost, retry, budget, and endpoint policy; these cannot be supplied here.

requestId.description: Host-assigned stable request/cancellation identity bound to the exact authenticated Session, message, and tool call; model cannot choose an identity for another request.

domains.description: Optional bounded query-filter intent passed to the selected providers. It is not an authorization boundary or route selector; HostKernel validates syntax and binds the exact value to the authenticated Guard-approved request.

deadlineMs.description: Bounded caller-requested duration; HostKernel applies its stricter aggregate deadline.

cancellationId.description: Host-issued opaque cancellation correlation identity; cancellation is authorized and scoped by authenticated host state, never by the model.
